Dashboard Settings

Hub credentials (token) are saved to this browser only — never sent off the hub. Dashboard config (tiles, layout, visibility) can be saved to the hub for cross-device sync via Save Config to Hub below. Your hub's UID namespaces your config so multiple hubs can share one Worker.

Hub Connection

Saved to this browser only — never sent off the hub.
Save Config to Hub — syncs tile layout, labels, and visibility to all devices. Hub token is never included. Close — saves everything to this browser only.
Wipes all config from the hub and this browser — cannot be undone.

Status Bar

Select which presence sensors appear as chips at the top of every view.
Load devices first — click "Reload Devices & Test" above.

Custom Dashboards

Create a named dashboard and populate it with any devices from your Maker API. Access it from the nav bar.

Auto-generated Dashboards

Automatically show navigation tabs for common device types found on your hub. Individual visibility can still be adjusted in the section below. To add new auto-generated groups, extend DYNAMIC_GROUPS in the source.

Dashboard Order & Visibility

Drag to reorder dashboards. Uncheck to hide from navigation.

Local Backup & Restore

Download or paste your config as JSON. These operations work on your browser's copy — use Save to Hub above to push a restored config to all devices.
